metadata.notes: Multi-input analysis of PRD, RFC, and Figma screens for Create Listing (Multi-Type).

evidence: Goals, listing types, user stories, requirements FR-1 to FR-14, acceptance criteria
Architecture, data model, type strategies, state machine, API contracts, testing
What are you listing? Pick a type. You can't change it after publishing.

features.name: Listing Type Selection and Eligibility
features.description: Choosing listing type and verifying seller eligibility across Standard, Buyer Protection, Luxury, OM, and Bulk.

features.name: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
features.description: Common form fields, validation, and auto-saving drafts across all listing types.

features.name: Buyer Protection Listing Type
features.description: Buyer protection fee calculation, tracked shipping requirement, and escrow payout timeline.

features.name: Luxury Listing Type and Authentication
features.description: Minimum price, brand/model/serial numbers, proof of purchase, and Pending Review state.

features.name: Offer Mode Listing Type
features.description: Asking price, hidden minimum offer, offer expiry windows, and auto-declining low offers.

features.name: Bulk Listing Type and Tiered Pricing
features.description: MOQ, stock count, tiered pricing by quantity, and verified GSTIN requirement.

features.name: Preview, State Machine and Publishing
features.description: Buyer preview rendering, state machine transitions, idempotency, and publish confirmation.

requirements.text: The type selector is the first step, displaying all 5 listing types with a one-line description and eligibility status.
Ineligible listing types are visible but disabled, displaying the reason and instructions on how to qualify.
The system shall auto-save drafts every 10 seconds and upon step changes.
All common listing fields (Title, Category, Condition, Description, Photos, Quantity, Shipping, Pickup location, Return policy) must be validated according to defined rules.
For Buyer Protection listings, display the protection fee and payout timeline before publishing, and require tracked shipping to be enabled.
Buyer Protection listing cards and detail pages must display a Buyer Protection badge.
Luxury listings require a price of at least ₹50,000, along with brand, model, and serial number inputs.
Luxury listings require proof of purchase upload and at least 4 photos including serial number and logo close-ups.
On submit, Luxury listings enter Pending Review state until authentication passes, then become Live with a Verified Luxury badge.
For Offer Mode listings, sellers set an asking price; minimum offer is optional, must be <= asking price, and is never shown to buyers.
Sellers set offer expiry (24, 48, or 72 hours), and offers below the minimum are auto-declined.
Bulk listings require MOQ and up to 5 price tiers, where each tier's unit price must be strictly lower than the previous tier.
GSTIN must be verified on the business account before publishing a Bulk listing.
The preview screen must render the listing exactly as a buyer sees it, per listing type.
Publish confirmation must show listing ID, status, and a link to the listing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Seller can select any of the 5 listing types on Step 1.
Ineligible types are disabled with a visible reason and path to qualify.
Draft auto-saves and restores after closing browser or app.
Buyer Protection badge shows on the listing card and detail page.
Luxury listing below ₹50,000 cannot be published.
Luxury listing stays Pending Review until authentication passes.
OM minimum offer is never returned in any buyer-facing API or page.
OM offers below the minimum are auto-declined.
Bulk tiers with non-decreasing prices are rejected with an inline error.
Preview matches the published buyer view for every type.

business_rules.text: Title must be 10-80 characters, no phone numbers or URLs.
Photos must be 1-10 images, JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 10 MB each, min 800x800 px.
OM minimum offer must be less than or equal to the asking price.
Bulk price tiers must contain up to 5 tiers, and each tier's unit price must be strictly lower than the previous tier.

preconditions: Seller is authenticated and logged into the application.

clarifications.question: What is the exact formula or fixed percentage for calculating the Buyer Protection fee displayed to buyers?
clarifications.why: Needed to verify exact calculation correctness in test data assertions.
clarifications.answer: Assumed 2% of listing price or flat tier fee based on demo design (e.g., ₹18,500 item has ₹370 fee).

assumptions.text: Buyer Protection fee calculation uses a standard 2% rate as illustrated in Figma design 03a.
